1.explanation:
• TooltipDefinition.js – This is where the `children` PropType is declared and the rendering of the trigger button happens. To support arbitrary React elements instead of strings, the PropType for `children` must be changed from PropTypes.string to PropTypes.node (or equivalent) and the component’s wrapper markup must allow nesting inside other elements.
• TooltipDefinition-test.js – The unit tests currently only exercise string children and snapshot expectations. After changing the PropType and markup, tests should include a case passing an element (e.g.

), and assertions must be updated accordingly.
• __snapshots__/TooltipDefinition-test.js.snap – The stored Jest snapshots will no longer match after updating how elements render as children. These snapshots must be refreshed to reflect the new output when non-string children are used.
